  "candidate_rtl": "module addr_calcu(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] ptr1, ptr2,
    input [7:0] b,
    input control,
    output [15:0] count
);

    parameter [7:0] base = 8'b10000000;

    wire [7:0] selected_pointer;
    wire [7:0] q;
    wire q_nonzero;

    assign selected_pointer = control ? ptr1 : ptr2;
    // Mandatory modulo-256 arithmetic. For base=8'h80 this is
    // just inversion of the selected pointer's most significant bit.
    assign q = selected_pointer - base;
    assign q_nonzero = |q;

    // Carry-save representation of address + b + q.
    wire [7:0] sum_bits;
    wire [7:0] majority_bits;
    wire [7:0] shifted_carry;
    assign sum_bits = address ^ b ^ q;
    assign majority_bits = (address & b) | (address & q) | (b & q);
    assign shifted_carry = {majority_bits[6:0], 1'b0};

    // Eight-bit parallel-prefix carry propagation, with carry-in zero.
    wire [7:0] p0, g0;
    wire [7:0] p1, g1;
    wire [7:0] p2, g2;
    wire [7:0] g3;
    wire [7:0] low_sum;
    wire carry8;

    assign p0 = sum_bits ^ shifted_carry;
    assign g0 = sum_bits & shifted_carry;

    assign g1 = g0 | (p0 & (g0 << 1));
    assign p1 = p0 & ((p0 << 1) | 8'h01);
    assign g2 = g1 | (p1 & (g1 << 2));
    assign p2 = p1 & ((p1 << 2) | 8'h03);
    assign g3 = g2 | (p2 & (g2 << 4));

    assign low_sum = p0 ^ {g3[6:0], 1'b0};
    assign carry8 = g3[7];

    // Recover the high byte after subtracting 256 when q is nonzero.
    wire negative_result;
    wire result_bit8;
    assign negative_result = q_nonzero & ~majority_bits[7] & ~carry8;
    assign result_bit8 = majority_bits[7] ^ carry8 ^ q_nonzero;
    assign count = {{7{negative_result}}, result_bit8, low_sum};

endmodule",
